financing.label: Financing
financing.trigger: S-1, F-1, 424B1/424B4/424B5 or 8-K item 3.02 filed with the SEC (company raised or registered new equity)
financing.research: char-matched 126d excess -3.9% (t -7.8) for issuers with a prior insider buy; S-1/F-1 -21.5%; 8-K 3.02 -5.7%; 424B primary -1.6%; significant in 2006-15 and 2016-26
financing.text: In our research, US stocks lagged similar companies by about 4% on average over the 6 months after a company financing filing (much more after S-1/F-1 registrations).

insider_sale.label: Insider sale
insider_sale.trigger: SEDI open-market sale (nature 10) filed <= 10 days after the trade, >= C$10k per company per filing day; CEO/CFO or >= 50% of holding marked escalated
insider_sale.research: char-matched 126d excess -4.4% (t -5.2); CEO/CFO -9.1%; >= 50% of holding -5.1%; post-2025-04 test same sign (t -1.5)
insider_sale.text: In our research, Canadian stocks lagged similar companies by about 4% on average over the 6 months after insider open-market sales.

sell_after_buy.label: Sold after buy
sell_after_buy.trigger: same insider sells within 180 days after their own open-market buy (Canada >= C$10k; US not 10b5-1, >= US$100k); active 91 days
sell_after_buy.research: US xc63 -3.0% (t -2.9), CA xp63 -2.75% (t -2.5); not significant out of sample; fails Bonferroni
sell_after_buy.text: In our research, a sale within 6 months of the same insider's own buy was a mild negative sign on average (about 3% over the next 3 months), and it was not statistically reliable in later years.
